an explosive issue: Raising taxes is an explosive issue in this election, and both sides get very angry whenever it comes up.
加稅是這次選舉中一觸即發的敏感議題，每次被提起，雙方都非常憤怒。
explosive growth: The online shopping market saw explosive growth during the pandemic, when people could not go to stores.
疫情期間人們無法去商店，網購市場因此出現爆炸性成長。
an explosive temper: My uncle has an explosive temper; he starts shouting and throwing things over the smallest problems.
我叔叔脾氣暴躁易怒，一點小問題就開始大吼、摔東西。
an explosive situation: With angry crowds on both sides of the street, the police knew it was an explosive situation.
街道兩側都是憤怒的群眾，警方知道這是一觸即發的局勢。
expressive eyes: The actress has such expressive eyes that she can show sadness or joy without saying a word.
這位女演員有一雙會說話的眼睛，不必說一句話就能表現悲傷或喜悅。
an expressive face: Children love the clown because he has an expressive face that changes from surprise to joy in a second.
孩子們喜歡這個小丑，因為他有一張表情豐富的臉，一秒內就能從驚訝變成歡喜。
be expressive of: The dark colors in his paintings are expressive of the loneliness he felt after moving abroad.
他畫中的暗色調表達出他移居國外後所感受到的孤單。
extensive damage: The typhoon caused extensive damage across the island, destroying hundreds of homes and farms.
颱風在全島造成大範圍的損害，摧毀了數百棟房屋和農田。
extensive research: After years of extensive research in many countries, the scientist finally published her book on bird migration.
經過多年在許多國家的廣泛研究，這位科學家終於出版了她關於鳥類遷徙的書。
extensive experience: We hired Mr. Lin because he has extensive experience, having worked in hotels for over twenty years.
我們僱用林先生，因為他有豐富的經驗，已在飯店業工作超過二十年。
extensive reading: Our teacher encourages extensive reading of many easy books, not just careful study of one textbook.
我們的老師鼓勵廣泛閱讀許多簡單的書，而不只是仔細研讀一本課本。
the exterior walls: The workers are painting the exterior walls of the school white, while the classrooms inside stay blue.
工人正在把學校的外牆漆成白色，而裡面的教室維持藍色。
a calm exterior: Although she showed a calm exterior during the interview, her heart was beating very fast.
雖然她在面試時表現出表面的平靜，她的心臟卻跳得很快。
beneath the tough exterior: Beneath the tough exterior, our strict coach is a kind man who cares deeply about every player.
在強硬的外表下，我們嚴格的教練其實是個深深關心每位球員的好心人。
external pressure: The company changed its policy because of external pressure from customers and the media, not because it wanted to.
這家公司改變政策是因為來自顧客和媒體的外部壓力，而非出於自願。
external factors: Bad weather and rising oil prices are external factors that the farmers cannot control.
惡劣天氣和油價上漲是農民無法控制的外在因素。
for external use only: The label on the cream says it is for external use only, so never put it in your mouth.
這條藥膏的標籤寫著僅供外用，所以千萬不要放進嘴裡。
external affairs: As minister of external affairs, she often travels abroad to meet leaders of other countries.
身為對外事務部長，她經常出國和其他國家的領袖會面。
become extinct: If people keep cutting down the forests, many kinds of animals will become extinct within fifty years.
如果人們繼續砍伐森林，許多種動物將在五十年內絕種。
an extinct volcano: The hill behind our village is an extinct volcano that has not erupted for thousands of years.
我們村子後面的山丘是一座死火山，已經好幾千年沒有噴發過了。
be in danger of becoming extinct: Because so few of them are left in the wild, pandas used to be in danger of becoming extinct.
因為野外剩下的數量太少，貓熊過去曾瀕臨絕種。
extraordinary measures: The hospital took extraordinary measures, such as turning the gym into a ward, to treat all the patients.
醫院採取了非常手段，例如把體育館改成病房，來治療所有病患。
an extraordinary general meeting: The shareholders called an extraordinary general meeting because they could not wait until the yearly meeting.
股東們召開了臨時股東大會，因為他們等不及一年一度的例行會議。
extraordinary circumstances: Under extraordinary circumstances like a war, the government may delay the election.
在戰爭這類特殊情況下，政府可能會延後選舉。
It is extraordinary that…: It is extraordinary that the old man survived five days in the mountains with no food at all.
這位老人在山裡完全沒有食物還撐了五天，真是令人驚訝。
extreme weather: Heat waves, floods, and super typhoons are kinds of extreme weather that are becoming more common.
熱浪、水災和超級颱風都是越來越常見的極端天氣。
extreme sports: My brother loves extreme sports such as skydiving and bungee jumping, which make my mother very nervous.
我哥哥熱愛跳傘和高空彈跳等極限運動，讓我媽媽非常緊張。
go to extremes: Dieting is fine, but don't go to extremes and stop eating completely for days.
節食沒關係，但不要走極端，好幾天完全不吃東西。
in the extreme: Walking alone in that dark forest at night would be dangerous in the extreme.
晚上獨自走在那片漆黑的森林裡會極度地危險。
extreme poverty: Millions of people still live in extreme poverty, without enough money for food or clean water.
仍有數百萬人生活在赤貧中，沒有足夠的錢買食物或乾淨的水。
take extreme measures: To save the dying business, the owner had to take extreme measures, such as firing half the staff.
為了挽救垂死的生意，老闆不得不採取極端措施，例如裁掉一半員工。
